title: Oracle consensus input validation
status: source repair and focused checks pass; capability not accepted
changes: Median and weighted consensus reject non-finite/non-positive prices, out-of-range or non-finite confidence, missing source identities, and naive timestamps.
Source identity comparison trims whitespace and ignores case; readings from duplicate source identities are excluded rather than counted as independent feeds.
Median deviation thresholds must be finite and non-negative; weighted consensus excludes and reports zero-weight sources.

verification.ruff: python3 -m ruff check services/ingestion/oracle_aggregator.py tests/test_oracle_infrastructure.py: passed
specific_cases: Non-finite and negative prices and naive timestamps are excluded.
Duplicate source names differing by case or whitespace are not counted as independent providers.
Invalid-confidence and zero-weight entries do not distort weighted prices.

scope_limits: No live price provider, database, blockchain, MQTT broker, or actuator was contacted.

Physical actuation remains unaccepted: the current low-level MQTT publisher is not linked to the persisted approval state, and operator authorization, delivery idempotency, and device acknowledgment still need a safe contract.
Feed freshness, reference-price parity, consensus tolerances, on-chain behavior, and MAN-CAP-055 review remain open.
